lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters organized into roughly vertical columns; inter-cluster spacing increases along the anterior-posterior axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that align with the columns of circular blobs, creating a discernible grid-like intersection pattern across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear horizontal feature in the upper third of the visible flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.
